_about: Which standards GOVERN an equipment type (#725 F5, #733). Keys are the equipment types of reference/equipment_vocabulary.json (one vocabulary: subject_scope reads what a submittal is from it). A governing standard that the library holds is selected for a submittal of that type (method governing_standard, included) with the type and where it was read; one the library does not hold is listed as governing_not_held, never as met. materials_standards apply only to material fields of a datasheet (subject_scope.materials_gate). Generic engineering standards only; edit here, not in code.
